articles.title: She Left GameSpot After 12 Years to Start a Secret Game-Finding Club!
articles.summary: Lucy James quit her job at GameSpot to start a newsletter that sends you demo codes for cool PC games. She’s teaming up with Geoff Keighley and a new platform called Player.gg to help you discover your next favorite game.

articles.title: Apple’s Cheap MacBook Neo Made a Splash — Now Everyone Wants to Copy It!
articles.summary: Apple’s $599 MacBook Neo shook up the laptop world. Now Dell and Microsoft are making their own cheap, 8 GB laptops. Dell’s new XPS 13 looks fancy like the Neo, but Microsoft’s Surface might be making a big mistake.

articles.title: Overwatch’s Pride Story Gave Lifeweaver a New Boyfriend — and Broke a Fan-Favorite Ship!
articles.summary: Overwatch’s Pride event finally gives Lifeweaver a love story, but it’s with a new character, not Baptiste. Fans who shipped the two heroes might be sad, but the comic is super cute and full of adventure.
